host linux-x86_64
format ustar+gzip
partBytes 89000000

Canonical vendor snapshot used when ./build.sh vendor cannot build. Wasm bytes are portable. Lua and Shell may differ on darwin-arm64 because that wasi-sdk compiler-rt differs; this archive is the linux-x86_64 reference when packed there. linux-state.zst is one save_state() snapshot and is not stable across regenerations. Rust is committed under wasm/rust/ and is not in these archives.
